purpose: Neutral state representation for domain adapters before transition composition

domain_state_fields.state_label: current observed or rule-derived state at timestamp
domain_state_fields.state_probability: descriptive score in [0,1], not causal confidence
domain_state_fields.source_observations: source variable values used to emit the state
domain_state_fields.lead_profile: lead/lag metadata; empty for a point-in-time state
domain_state_fields.uncertainty: coverage, estimation, revision, and measurement caveats
domain_state_fields.edge_status: not_testable for standalone state; transition layer may update it
domain_state_fields.evidence_refs: source IDs, versions, raw/staged artifact paths

rules: Do not use future outcome labels to emit a current state.
Keep native frequency and source definition unchanged.
No imputation, normalization, source averaging, or forced reconciliation.
A deterministic rule score is not a probability of causality.
TransitionEvidence is a separate object from DomainState.
